name: Tempeh with Charred Green Onion Sauce & Lemon-Parsley Roasted Beets

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 medium beets
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
½ lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim beets; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until beets are fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim green onions. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add green onions. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side; return to the plate. (Reserve grill pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces and place in a small bowl. Add oil and spices, then gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) package tempeh
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp smoked paprika
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the pan to medium-high heat. Add tempeh in a single layer and grill, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Add to the plate with the green onions, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the tempeh is cooking, place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp water
½ tsp garlic powder
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Mince grilled green onions. Add to the bowl with the yogurt and whisk once more to combine the yogurt sauce. Set aside.
Juice lemon into another small bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp honey
1 tsp Dijon mustard
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
To serve, divide green onion yogurt and beets between plates; top yogurt with tempeh and drizzle beets with dressing. Enjoy!
